caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a wooden shoe last, positioned horizontally with the toe pointing to the left and the heel to the right. The shoe last is depicted in natural shades of brown, showing wood grain texture, scratches, and wear marks throughout its surface. There are visible joints and lines that indicate the construction and usage of the item. It features a metal plate affixed near the heel with four screws and another small, round metal piece closer to the ankle area, as well as a small metal peg towards the heel. The background is a plain off-white or light beige, with no other objects or elements present. Near the bottom center of the image, faint text can be seen, but it is not prominent.
title: Shoe Last
